newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Vietnam end talks, no results announced.
newsitem.headline: China, Vietnam end talks, no results announced.

text.p: China and Vietnam on Friday wrapped up three days of talks aimed at resolving a dispute over oil drilling off the Vietnamese coast, but announced no results.

"China and Vietnam have concluded expert-level consultations on the Kan Tan III," the Foreign Ministry said, referring to China's oil and gas exploration ship Kan Tan III that had been working in disputed seas about 64.5 nautical miles off the coast of central Vietnam.
"The expert groups from the two sides exchanged views in a friendly and frank atmosphere," the ministry. It gave no more details.
Officials said earlier that leaders of the expert-level teams from the two sides were meeting in a Beijing hotel, with other delegation members excluded from the final round.
Beijing said on Thursday the talks so far had resulted in greater understanding of each other's positions but warned that differences would take time to iron out.
